post.title: 2026: Medicare paid $7.77 per blood count. How labs profit
post.ig:
In 2026, Medicare paid $7.77 for a basic blood count (CBC). So how do labs make billions?
Quest Diagnostics brought in $11.04 billion in 2025.
It handled about 244 million test orders. Our math: $10.79 billion in testing revenue / 244 million orders = about $44 per order.
The price depends on the tests in each order and who pays: Medicare sets one national rate, insurers negotiate.
Medicare lab rates are being reset starting in 2027, so the $7.77 figure is the 2026 rate.
Sources: Quest Diagnostics FY2025 results and annual report, CMS Clinical Laboratory Fee Schedule (CY2026).
News and education, not financial advice.
